findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch, get_blog_posts, get_company_type, get_industry, get_local_ai_quality, get_local_ai_recipe, get_role, get_use_case, list_company_types, list_industries, list_local_ai_hardware, list_roles, list_use_cases, request_consultation, search_blog_knowledge · Private data: fetch, get_company_info · Public sink: request_consultation, search_blog_knowledge · Destructive: get_local_ai_quality, get_services.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch, get_blog_posts, get_company_type, get_industry, get_local_ai_quality, get_local_ai_recipe, get_role, get_use_case, list_company_types, list_industries, list_local_ai_hardware, list_roles, list_use_cases, request_consultation, search_blog_knowledge · Private data: fetch, get_company_info · Public sink: request_consultation, search_blog_knowledge · Destructive: get_local_ai_quality, get_services

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
